newsitem.title: USA: TVA Watts Bar nuke seen out several weeks.
newsitem.headline: TVA Watts Bar nuke seen out several weeks.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority's 1,170 megawatt Watts Bar nuclear power plant in Spring City, Tenn., will be shut for several weeks for scheduled maintenance, a company spokesman said.
"We will be doing some testing and some maintenance work, it should take a few weeks," spokesman Tom Tohill said Monday.
The unit was shut September 27 for mid-cycle maintenance. It is the first major maintenance outage for the plant, which began commercial operation on May 27, 1996, Tohill said.
Following expected startup in late October the plant is scheduled to be shut for refueling in the winter of 1997, the spokesman said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
